tex_content.label: grouptheory
tex_content.html:
If a group $G$ generated by $k$ elements has a decomposition $G=G_1*\cdots *G_\ell $ with every $G_i$ nontrivial, then $\ell \le k$.
Proof

\sketch Grushko’s theorem decomposes a rank-$k$ free group surjecting onto $G$ as $F_1*\cdots *F_\ell $, with $F_i\twoheadrightarrow G_i$; hence every $F_i$ has positive rank and $\ell \le k$ \cite{Stallings}.
